dict: check for interference, a blocked or overloaded axis
the motor may need service; contact IAI if it recurs
the controller may need service; contact IAI if it recurs
power-cycle; if it recurs, the controller or motor may need service
check the 24 V supply voltage and its capacity
check the parameter / position data that was sent
a maintenance threshold was reached: plan maintenance

the calendar (RTC) clock stopped and the time is lost: set the clock again, or switch the calendar off with No.111 = 0 if it is not used; not registered in the alarm list (ME0342-4H p.8-15; this driver does not set the clock)
a move was sent during the home return: wait for homing to finish
a software reset was sent with the servo on: alarm reset; switch the servo off before a software reset

parameter data error: e.g. soft limits in the wrong order, a rotary axis switched from index to normal mode with the - soft limit at 0, or No.10 (default positioning band) below the minimum band; correct the parameter, then software reset (ME0342-4H p.8-22)
bad position data: the detail is the row, the address the field (see detail); causes include an empty row, a target outside the soft limits and a relative row in solenoid mode 2 (ME0342-4H p.8-17)
bad direct-move data: the address names the field (see detail)
the deceleration was lowered during a move so that the axis would overrun the soft limit: send the next command earlier or keep the deceleration (ME0342-4H p.8-18)
the axis did not move for 2 s after a move command (blocked or held; also a cable fault, a brake not released or high sliding resistance, ME0342-4H p.8-19): free it, then alarm reset
control supply voltage too low: check the 24 V supply and its capacity (treated as cold start to be safe; an alarm reset may already clear it)
motor supply voltage too high: check the 24 V supply (treated as cold start to be safe; an alarm reset may already clear it)
outside the soft limits: after the alarm reset move back inside them (slowly, or by hand)
collision detected: alarm reset; the EC may run its evacuation move
absolute position lost: absolute reset = alarm reset, servo on, home return (ME0342-4H p.4-130, p.8-21)
fieldbus link lost (fieldbus types): check the network parameters, the master and the cable (ME0342-4H p.8-21)
a monitoring data-type change was sent during monitoring: stop the monitoring first (ME0342-4H p.8-14)
a monitoring command was sent with monitoring disabled: No.112 selects the monitoring mode (ME0342-4H p.8-14)
a calendar (RTC) command was sent with the calendar disabled: No.111 = 1 enables it (ME0342-4H p.8-14)
collision warning: the axis keeps running
a Modbus frame header arrived but no valid frame within 5 s (ME0342-4H p.8-15): check the wiring, the baud rate and electrical noise
actuator-specific, set at shipment (do not change)
